ImageDescription.value: The predecessor road of road 427 in southwestern Iceland, per title from flickr "The Road to Grindavik", at the northwestern edge of Ögmundarhraun. The prominent conical peak behind is Skála-Mælifell (174m). Grindavík would be further left behind the farthest hills. The date per Exif data is "2008-11-11 07:13:00", but either the time or the month, or both, must be wrong, as the sun doesn't rise that early in Iceland in November.
